entities.name: Broadcast MRB establishment
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a broadcast Multicast Radio Bearer (MRB) in the UE, involving establishment of PDCP, RLC, and SDAP entities, configuration of physical layer, and reception of DL-SCH.

entities.name: MBSBroadcastConfiguration message
entities.description: Message containing configuration information for broadcast MRB establishment, including MRB-InfoBroadcast, mbs-SessionInfoList, searchSpaceMTCH, pdsch-ConfigMTCH, g-RNTI, and mtch-SchedulingInfo.

entities.name: MRB-InfoBroadcast
entities.description: Information element included in MBSBroadcastConfiguration message specifying configuration for broadcast MRB establishment.

entities.name: Temporary Mobile Group Identity
entities.description: Identifier used to identify the MBS broadcast service and establish corresponding SDAP entity.

entities.name: Group Radio Network Temporary Identifier
entities.description: Identifier used for receiving DL-SCH for the MBS broadcast service.

entities.name: PDCP entity
entities.description: Packet Data Convergence Protocol entity established for the broadcast MRB.

entities.name: RLC entity
entities.description: Radio Link Control entity established for the broadcast MRB.

entities.name: SDAP entity
entities.description: Service Data Adaptation Protocol entity established for the broadcast MRB when no existing entity with the same TMGI exists.

entities.name: SDAP entity with TMGI does not exist
entities.description: Condition that triggers establishment of a new SDAP entity for the broadcast MRB.

relations.description: Broadcast MRB establishment procedure uses configuration information from MBSBroadcastConfiguration message.
MBSBroadcastConfiguration message contains MRB-InfoBroadcast IE for broadcast MRB configuration.
Procedure establishes PDCP entity for the broadcast MRB.
Procedure establishes RLC entity for the broadcast MRB.
Procedure uses TMGI to identify the MBS broadcast service and inform upper layers.
Procedure uses g-RNTI for receiving DL-SCH for the MBS broadcast service.
Condition that no SDAP entity exists with the received TMGI triggers establishment of new SDAP entity.
Procedure checks condition whether SDAP entity with TMGI exists before establishing new SDAP entity.
